nodes.label: ADR-0077
nodes.rationale: Disclosed the durability gap: documents were durable but the objects constructed over them were not.

nodes.label: ADR-0144
nodes.rationale: One SQLite database tempest.db in WAL mode with synchronous=FULL replaces the file-per-key tree; the files backend cannot be atomic and is retired in v0.18.0.

nodes.label: One Authority Split by Concern
nodes.rationale: Document store and state store are one authority split by what each holds, not two competing ones; since ADR-0145 the split survives only as a reading split, the writing split is gone.

nodes.label: tempest.lock
nodes.rationale: Held exclusively so a second TempestOS instance on one root is refused rather than allowed to interleave writes.

nodes.label: No Save Step
nodes.rationale: State is written at creation and every state-changing mutation; a user cannot forget to save and a crash cannot lose the last edit.

nodes.label: IRehydratable<T>
nodes.rationale: Each type owns CaptureTypeState and Rehydrate symmetrically in its own file with nameof keys; there is no central switch over Kind and an unimplemented Rehydrate is a compile error.

nodes.label: IEngineeringObjectRehydratorRegistry
nodes.rationale: A Domain-layer contract because the only thing startup has is a Kind string from disk; declares no Kind of its own (ADR-0105).

nodes.label: DuplicateRehydratorRegistrationException
nodes.rationale: A different type for a claimed Kind throws; the identical type twice is a no-op so a composition root running registration twice is not punished.

nodes.label: EngineeringWorkspaceComposer.RehydrateEngineeringObjectsAsync
nodes.rationale: Both shells run it so Desktop and Harness recover identical work from the identical store.

nodes.label: Live Object Never Replaced by Snapshot
nodes.rationale: An object already in the repository may carry unwritten mutations; rehydration only fills in what the process does not already have.

nodes.label: CaptureState RestoreState Single Definition
nodes.rationale: Shared by persistence, rehydration and revision so a field added to it cannot be forgotten by one path and honoured by another; replaced a hand-picked subset that reset revised objects to Draft.

nodes.label: DocumentReference Attribution
nodes.rationale: Optional CreatedByPrincipalId and CreatedAt so a rebuilt relationship is not credited to whoever was signed in at startup; null for pre-TD-85 links, honestly absent rather than fabricated.

nodes.label: Index Updated Only After Commit
nodes.rationale: LinkAsync used to dual-write and a failure left the index and store disagreeing; the in-memory index is now a cache of committed state, never a co-equal writer (TD-143).

nodes.label: EngineeringRehydrationResult
nodes.rationale: Reports ObjectCount, UnknownKinds, OrphanedStateIds, FailedObjectIds, AlreadyLiveCount and IsComplete; one unreadable record never costs a user every other object.

nodes.label: ProjectDirectory Projects.Index Removed
nodes.rationale: Kept only because the object graph was not durable; now reads the one object graph.
